verdict.rationale: Anthropic has a dedicated first-party page on how Claude model IDs are structured and versioned. It covers pinned versioned IDs versus moving or dateless forms, with per-platform ID tables. The deprecations page adds a documented lifecycle policy with retirement floors. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of when and how aliases are repointed to new releases, independent or hands-on corroboration of pinning behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented

citations.quote: How Claude model IDs are structured and versioned, including the dateless form
pinned versioned IDs vs. moving forms, per-platform ID tables on the models overview
advance-notice deprecation policy with migration guides
